Coding Challenge.title: Two Sum
Coding Challenge.prompt: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target. You may assume that each input would have exactly one solution, and you may not use the same element twice. You can return the answer in any order.

Coding Challenge.title: Palindrome Number
Coding Challenge.prompt: Given an integer x, return true if x is a palindrome, and false otherwise.

examples.explanation: 121 reads as 121 from left to right and from right to left.

Coding Challenge.title: Reverse Integer
Coding Challenge.prompt: Given a signed 32-bit integer x, return x with its digits reversed. If reversing x causes the value to go outside the signed 32-bit integer range [-2^31, 2^31 - 1], then return 0.

Coding Challenge.title: Maximum Subarray
Coding Challenge.prompt: Given an integer array nums, find the subarray with the largest sum, and return its sum.

examples.explanation: The subarray [4,-1,2,1] has the largest sum 6.

Coding Challenge.title: Trapping Rain Water
Coding Challenge.prompt: Given n non-negative integers representing an elevation map where the width of each bar is 1, compute how much water it can trap after raining.
